h1_old: How to Dismiss a Traffic Ticket in Austin with Defensive Driving

faqs.q: How much does it cost to dismiss a ticket in Austin?
faqs.a: The court cost is typically up to about $144 ($169 in a school zone), set by each court — some Austin-area courts charge less. The TDLR-approved course is separate; ours is $28. Check your court's page for the exact amount.

faqs.q: Can I take the Austin defensive driving course online?
faqs.a: Yes. Once the court approves your request, a TDLR-approved 6-hour course can be completed fully online. Every Austin-area court accepts a state-approved online course.

faqs.q: My ticket is from Round Rock / Cedar Park / San Marcos, not Austin. Does that change things?
faqs.a: The legal steps are the same, but you deal with that city's court — and it's often in Williamson or Hays County, with its own fee, request method, and deadlines. Open its page in the table above.

faqs.q: How long do I have to finish?
faqs.a: Generally 90 days after the court approves the request. Request the course by your appearance date first, and don't pay the ticket — paying is a guilty plea and a conviction.

faqs.q: Does a dismissal keep it off my insurance?
faqs.a: Yes. A driving safety course dismissal keeps the charge off your driving record under Texas law, so it can't raise your insurance — unlike paying, which is a conviction.

courts.name: Austin Municipal Court
courts.note: You'll need a certified Type 3A driving record from Texas DPS — most drivers do not have this ready.

courts.name: Bee Cave City Of Municipal Court
courts.note: Bee Cave (Travis County, SH-71/Galleria) charges $144 ($169 school zone) by your appearance date — late fees apply after; 90 days to finish.

courts.name: Briarcliff Municipal Court
courts.note: Briarcliff (Travis County, Lake Travis) hasn't posted its DSC fee and meets monthly — call (512) 264-2274 by your appearance date to request it.

courts.name: Buda Municipal Court
courts.note: Buda's mailed DSC request must be notarized, and certificates dated before court approval are rejected. $144 fee.

courts.name: Cedar Park Municipal Court
courts.note: Cedar Park requires a signed DSC affidavit before you can enroll — most drivers miss this until it is too late.

courts.note: Florence (Williamson County, US-183) charges $144 ($169 school zone) with a notarized affidavit — request within 30 days of the citation; no extensions.

courts.note: Georgetown requires a signed DSC affidavit before you enroll — most drivers miss this step. Court fee: $144.
